report: Rhamondre Stevenson is questionable for Sunday, and Woody Marks is the cover if he sits. At 2-7 you need wins, and the current lineup is already the best available, so there are no start or sit changes. The weak spots are QB (Stafford averages 15.87 but only 12.33 over his last 3), RB2 (Rachaad White at 9.74) and a TE who has fallen to 5.5 over his last 3 (LaPorta). The most important trade is Tank Dell to zaneruth for C.J. Stroud: Stroud averages 20.51 with a 16.48 floor, he sits on zaneruth's bench behind Daniels, and Dell fills zaneruth's WR3 hole. Also make two waiver moves, Emanuel Wilson for Seth McGowan and Xavier Hutchinson for Rashid Shaheed.

team_breakdown.note: Stafford averages 15.87 but only 12.33 over his last 3 (ceiling 23.33). The ARI matchup (rank 2 against QBs) helps this week, but he is a mid-tier starter.
Javonte Williams is a true RB1 at 17.73 on 23 carries per game. White at 9.74 and Stevenson at 12.63 (questionable) are the weak spots.
Higgins averages 19.98 (28.17 over his last 3) and McMillan 15.56. Depth is thin, and Jameson Williams faces NE, which ranks 2 against WRs.
LaPorta averages 11.64 but only 5.5 over his last 3 (floor 6.78). He plays 90% of snaps, so the role is fine and the production is what has dipped.
The flex spots are Jameson Williams at 13.21 and Stevenson at 12.63, who is hurt. Behind them nobody on the bench averages above 9.31.
Black (4.71), McGowan (3.63), Strong (5.5) and Shaheed (6.03) are dead weight. Wilson and Hutchinson are better than all of them.

plan: Land a better QB: Stroud (20.51 average) for Tank Dell is worth about +4.6 per week.
Fix the RB2/flex hole with Kamara or Coleman, or by playing Emanuel Wilson (10.69).
Replace the weakest bench spots with Hutchinson (8.29, 81% snaps) and Wilson, then work on a steadier TE.

replacements.why: Marks: 17.3 carries per game and an 8.28 floor, the safest cover.

waivers.why: 10.69 avg, 12.3 last 3, 19.3 carries per game; McGowan averages 3.63.
8.29 avg, 81% snaps, vs CLE (rank 22 vs WR); Shaheed has 32% snaps.

trades.why: Stroud is the target: 20.51 average, 24.95 over his last 3, 16.48 floor, and a CLE matchup that ranks 25th against QBs. That is +4.6 per game over Stafford (15.87) and a steadier floor (16.48 vs 9.12), so this is a MORE POINTS and MORE RELIABLE move. zaneruth starts Jayden Daniels (19.42), so Stroud sits on his bench. Dell (13.0 average) would start over Bernard (9.54) at WR3 for him.
trades.opener: Dell for Stroud, since you start Daniels anyway?
trades.fallback: Add Flournoy to Dell; walk away if he wants Higgins.

trades.why: Coleman is the target: 12.58 average, 16.03 over his last 3, 77% snap share, 12.33 carries per game and a 7.12 floor. He is more RELIABLE than Stevenson (12.63 average, questionable, 60% snaps, 5.52 floor). cash50's RB2 is Derrick Henry, who has faded to 8.49 over his last 3, and Stevenson has scored 16.43 over his last 3 against DET's RB defense (rank 30), so he gets a starter now.
trades.fallback: Add Strong as a sweetener; walk away if he asks for Higgins.

He is steadier than LaPorta (11.64 average, 5.5 over his last 3, 6.78 floor). garfy has Kraft (10.04) and Loveland (9.26) behind him, so he is not left with no TE. The offer brings him WR depth and a TE backup, which helps a 2-7 team with thin WR spots.
